title: Injectivity of the selector encoding
statement: Let $S$ be a finite type with decidable equality, let $k$ be a natural number, and let the selector set consist of the two forms specified by $	exttt{TabSel}$: a state option paired with an output-register value, or a tape-index option paired with two bits. Encode each selector as the Boolean function on the selector set’s finite cardinality that is $1$ at its own index under a fixed enumeration and $0$ elsewhere. This encoding is injective.
